title: dryopteris puberula
intro: Dryopteris puberula, commonly known as the hairy male fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris puberula are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
